<title>Event Blueprint</title>
<!-- EA-SYS: fonts self-hosted (public/blueprint-fonts/), not loaded from Google -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="/blueprint-fonts/fonts.css">
<style>
/* Layout: a guided studio. Phone: stepper chips on top, one section at a time, sticky Back/Next.
   Desktop (>=980px): section rail on the left with live status, section in the centre, readiness on the right. */
:root {
  --bg: #f2f1ef; --surface: #ffffff; --surface-2: #f7f6f4; --ink: #18161b; --ink-2: #4b4750; --muted: #67626c;
  --line: #e1dedb; --line-2: #cfcbc6; --accent: #8f1f33; --accent-ink: #ffffff; --accent-soft: #f5e6e9;
  --ok: #2c7a4b; --ok-soft: #e3f1e8; --warn: #8a5200; --warn-soft: #f8eedc; --bad: #b3261e; --bad-soft: #f9e5e3; --focus: #1d5fbf;
  --f-display: "Gloock", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif;
  --f-body: "Onest", "Segoe UI", system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
  --f-mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace;
}
@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :root:not([data-theme="light"]) {
  --bg: #121115; --surface: #1b1a1f; --surface-2: #222127; --ink: #f1eef0; --ink-2: #c9c4cc; --muted: #9a94a0;
  --line: #2e2c33; --line-2: #3d3a43; --accent: #e0576d; --accent-ink: #1a0e11; --accent-soft: #3a1c23;
  --ok: #5cc28a; --ok-soft: #173325; --warn: #e3a84b; --warn-soft: #3a2c14; --bad: #f07a70; --bad-soft: #3d1b19; --focus: #7fb0ff; color-scheme: dark; } }
:root[data-theme="dark"] {
  --bg: #121115; --surface: #1b1a1f; --surface-2: #222127; --ink: #f1eef0; --ink-2: #c9c4cc; --muted: #9a94a0;
  --line: #2e2c33; --line-2: #3d3a43; --accent: #e0576d; --accent-ink: #1a0e11; --accent-soft: #3a1c23;
  --ok: #5cc28a; --ok-soft: #173325; --warn: #e3a84b; --warn-soft: #3a2c14; --bad: #f07a70; --bad-soft: #3d1b19; --focus: #7fb0ff; color-scheme: dark; }

* { box-sizing: border-box; }
body { background: var(--bg); color: var(--ink); font: 15px/1.55 var(--f-body); }
button, input, select, textarea { font: inherit; color: inherit; }
button { cursor: pointer; }
:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: 2px; }
h1, h2, h3 { font-family: var(--f-display); font-weight: 400; text-wrap: balance; margin: 0; letter-spacing: -0.01em; }
.wrap { max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; padding-inline: 16px; }
.eyebrow { font: 600 11px/1 var(--f-body); letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent); }
.muted { color: var(--muted); }
.mono { font-family: var(--f-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

/* top bar */
.top { position: sticky; top: env(safe-area-inset-top, 0px); z-index: 5; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 88%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); }
.top .wrap { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding-block: 10px; }
.brand { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-width: 0; flex: 1; }
.mark { width: 30px; height: 30px; flex: none; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink); display: grid; place-items: center; font: 400 17px/1 var(--f-display); }
.brand .t { font: 400 19px/1.1 var(--f-display); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.brand .s { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
.brand > div { min-width: 0; }
.save { font: 500 11.5px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); white-space: nowrap; }
.ring { width: 42px; height: 42px; flex: none; position: relative; }
.ring svg { width: 42px; height: 42px; transform: rotate(-90deg); }
.ring b { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; place-items: center; font: 600 11.5px var(--f-mono); }
.ghostbtn { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); padding: 7px 11px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; min-height: 40px; }
.ghostbtn:hover { border-color: var(--ink); }

@media (max-width: 600px) { .save { display: none; } }
/* stepper */
.steps { display: flex; gap: 6px; overflow-x: auto; padding: 10px 16px 12px; scrollbar-width: none; max-width: 1240px; margin: 0 auto; }
.steps::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.step { flex: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 7px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink-2); min-height: 40px; }
.step[aria-current="step"] { border-color: var(--ink); color: var(--ink); box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--accent); }
.dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; flex: none; background: var(--line-2); }
.dot.g { background: var(--ok); } .dot.a { background: var(--warn); } .dot.r { background: var(--bad); }

/* layout */
.layout { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 20px; padding-block: 18px 120px; }
.rail, .side { display: none; }
@media (min-width: 980px) {
  .steps { display: none; }
  .layout { grid-template-columns: 220px minmax(0, 1fr) 280px; align-items: start; }
  .rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; position: sticky; top: 80px; }
  .rail button { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-align: left; background: transparent; border: 0; padding: 8px 10px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); }
  .rail button[aria-current="step"] { background: var(--surface); color: var(--ink); font-weight: 600; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 var(--accent); }
  .rail .n { font: 500 11px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); width: 18px; }
  .side { display: block; position: sticky; top: 80px; }
}
main { min-width: 0; }
.panel { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 22px 20px 24px; }
@media (min-width: 640px) { .panel { padding: 30px 32px 32px; } }
.phead { display: grid; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 22px; }
.phead h2 { font-size: clamp(28px, 5vw, 38px); line-height: 1.05; }
.phead p { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-2); max-width: 62ch; }
.fields { display: grid; gap: 22px; }
.f { display: grid; gap: 8px; min-width: 0; }
.f > label, .f .lab { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14.5px; display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.req { font: 600 10px var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 5px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); color: var(--muted); }
.req.need { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
.help { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); margin-top: -4px; max-width: 64ch; }
.two { display: grid; gap: 22px; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
@media (min-width: 720px) { .two { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
input[type=text], input[type=url], input[type=date], input[type=number], textarea, select {
  width: 100%; background: var(--surface-2); border: 1px solid var(--line-2); padding: 11px 12px; font-size: 16px; min-height: 46px; border-radius: 0; }
textarea { min-height: 96px; resize: vertical; line-height: 1.5; }
input:focus, textarea:focus, select:focus { outline: 2px solid var(--focus); outline-offset: -1px; border-color: transparent; }
::placeholder { color: var(--muted); opacity: 1; }

/* chips */
.chips { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 7px; }
.chip { border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: var(--surface); padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; }
.chip:hover { border-color: var(--ink-2); }
.chip[aria-pressed="true"] { background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); border-color: var(--ink); }

/* cards: paths and types */
.cards { display: grid; gap: 10px; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
@media (min-width: 640px) { .cards.c3 { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } .cards.c2 { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); } }
.card { text-align: left; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: var(--surface); padding: 16px 16px 15px; display: grid; gap: 6px; align-content: start; min-width: 0; }
.card:hover { border-color: var(--ink-2); }
.card[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
.card .ct { font: 400 21px/1.15 var(--f-display); }
.card .cd { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.card .ck { font: 600 10.5px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.types { display: grid; gap: 8px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(150px, 1fr)); }
.type { text-align: left; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: var(--surface); padding: 12px; display: grid; gap: 4px; min-height: 86px; align-content: start; }
.type:hover { border-color: var(--ink-2); }
.type[aria-pressed="true"] { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
.type .tn { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.25; }
.type .te { font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.35; }

/* row editors */
.rows { display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.row { display: grid; gap: 6px; grid-template-columns: var(--cols); align-items: start; }
.row input, .row select { min-height: 42px; padding: 9px 10px; }
.rowhead { display: grid; gap: 6px; grid-template-columns: var(--cols); font: 600 10.5px var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.del { min-height: 42px; width: 42px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); font-size: 18px; color: var(--muted); }
.del:hover { color: var(--bad); border-color: var(--bad); }
@media (max-width: 639px) {
  .row { grid-template-columns: 1fr 42px; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); }
  .row > *:not(.del) { grid-column: 1; }
  .row .del { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
  .rowhead { display: none; }
  .row [data-ph]::placeholder { opacity: 1; }
}
.addrow { justify-self: start; background: transparent; border: 1px dashed var(--line-2); padding: 9px 14px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; min-height: 40px; }
.addrow:hover { border-color: var(--ink); }
.tools { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.assist { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); border: 1px solid var(--accent); padding: 9px 14px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; min-height: 40px; display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; }
.assist:disabled { opacity: .6; cursor: progress; }
.tpl { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 9px 14px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13.5px; min-height: 40px; }
.note { font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); }
.note.err { color: var(--bad); }
.sumline { font: 500 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); }

/* concept studio */
.studio { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); padding: 16px; display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.studio h3 { font-size: 22px; }
.concepts { display: grid; gap: 10px; }
.concepts { grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr)); }
.concept { border: 1px solid var(--line-2); background: var(--surface); padding: 16px; display: grid; gap: 8px; align-content: start; }
.concept[aria-current="true"] { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px var(--accent); }
.concept .cn { font: 400 22px/1.1 var(--f-display); }
.concept p { margin: 0; font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.concept .lbl { font: 600 10px var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); margin-top: 4px; }
.concept .use { justify-self: start; margin-top: 6px; }
.skeleton { height: 150px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--surface) 0%, var(--surface-2) 50%, var(--surface) 100%); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: sh 1.4s infinite; border: 1px solid var(--line); }
@keyframes sh { to { background-position: -200% 0; } }

/* readiness side + review */
.ready { background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 18px; display: grid; gap: 12px; }
.ready .big { font: 400 44px/1 var(--f-display); }
.bar { height: 6px; background: var(--line); }
.bar i { display: block; height: 100%; background: var(--accent); transition: width .3s; }
.secstat { display: grid; gap: 0; font-size: 13px; }
.secstat button { min-height: 40px; }
.secstat div { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.missing { display: grid; gap: 6px; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; }
.missing li { display: flex; gap: 8px; font-size: 13.5px; align-items: baseline; }
.missing .tag { font: 600 9.5px var(--f-mono); padding: 2px 5px; flex: none; letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.tag.r { background: var(--bad-soft); color: var(--bad); } .tag.a { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); } .tag.g { background: var(--ok-soft); color: var(--ok); }
.missing button { background: none; border: 0; padding: 9px 0; min-height: 40px; color: var(--ink); text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; text-align: left; font-size: 13.5px; }
.brief { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); padding: 18px 18px 8px; overflow-x: auto; }
.brief h3 { font-size: 20px; margin: 16px 0 6px; }
.brief h3:first-child { margin-top: 0; }
.brief dl { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(110px, 180px) minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 4px 14px; margin: 0 0 6px; font-size: 14px; }
.brief dt { color: var(--muted); }
.brief dd { margin: 0; min-width: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
@media (max-width: 600px) { .brief dl { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 0; } .brief dt { font: 600 10.5px var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 8px; } }
.brief table { border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 13.5px; width: 100%; margin-bottom: 8px; }
.brief th, .brief td { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 6px 8px 6px 0; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; }
.brief th { font: 600 10.5px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: .05em; text-transform: uppercase; }
.actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
.primary { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-ink); border: 1px solid var(--accent); padding: 11px 18px; font-weight: 700; min-height: 46px; }
.secondary { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--ink); padding: 11px 16px; font-weight: 600; min-height: 46px; }
.toast { position: fixed; left: 16px; right: 16px; margin-inline: auto; width: fit-content; max-width: 560px; bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + 86px); background: var(--ink); color: var(--bg); padding: 10px 16px; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.4; z-index: 20; pointer-events: none; box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18); }
.reopen { color: var(--warn); font-weight: 600; }

/* bottom nav */
.nav { position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 6; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 92%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border-top: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 10px 16px calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + 10px); }
.nav .wrap { display: flex; gap: 10px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 0; }
.nav .where { font: 500 12px var(--f-mono); color: var(--muted); }

/* home */
.home { padding-block: 26px 120px; display: grid; gap: 28px; }
.hero { display: grid; gap: 14px; max-width: 760px; }
.hero h1 { font-size: clamp(38px, 8vw, 68px); line-height: .98; }
.hero p { margin: 0; font-size: 16.5px; color: var(--ink-2); max-width: 58ch; }
.saved { display: grid; gap: 8px; }
.sv { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 12px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface); text-align: left; }
.sv:hover { border-color: var(--ink-2); }
.sv .st { font-weight: 600; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.sv .sm { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--muted); }
.flow { display: grid; gap: 10px; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(200px, 1fr)); counter-reset: f; }
.flow div { border-top: 2px solid var(--ink); padding-top: 10px; font-size: 14px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.flow b { display: block; color: var(--ink); font-size: 15px; margin-bottom: 2px; }
.inline-confirm { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 12px; background: var(--warn-soft); border: 1px solid var(--warn); font-size: 13.5px; }

/* stage 1 additions */
.sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; padding: 0; margin: -1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0 0 0 0); white-space: nowrap; border: 0; }
.brand .s[data-state="bad"] { color: var(--bad); }
.phrow { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.qfbtn { font-size: 12.5px; }
.qfcard { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 14px; align-items: center; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); }
.qfcard .ct { font: 400 21px/1.15 var(--f-display); }
.qfcard .cd { font-size: 13.5px; color: var(--ink-2); margin-top: 3px; }
@media (max-width: 560px) { .qfcard { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } }
.sheet { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 30; background: rgba(10, 8, 12, .55); display: grid; place-items: center; padding: 16px; }
.qcard { width: min(640px, 100%); max-height: calc(100% - 24px); overflow: auto; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); padding: 22px 20px 20px; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
.qhead { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; align-items: start; }
.qhead h2 { font-size: 28px; line-height: 1.1; margin-top: 6px; }
.x { width: 40px; height: 40px; flex: none; background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); font-size: 20px; }
@media (max-width: 560px) { .sheet { place-items: end stretch; padding: 0; } .qcard { width: 100%; max-height: 92%; padding-bottom: calc(env(safe-area-inset-bottom, 0px) + 20px); } }
.qlist { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 6px; }
.qlist label { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); cursor: pointer; }
.qlist input { width: 18px; height: 18px; margin-top: 2px; accent-color: var(--accent); }
.ql { font: 600 10.5px var(--f-mono); letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); }
.qv { font-size: 14px; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.qo { font-size: 12.5px; color: var(--warn); margin-top: 2px; }
.check { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; font-size: 14px; }
.check input { width: 18px; height: 18px; accent-color: var(--accent); }
.linkbtn { background: none; border: 0; padding: 0; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; font-size: 13px; }
.pill { display: inline-block; font: 600 11px var(--f-body); letter-spacing: .04em; padding: 4px 9px; border: 1px solid var(--line-2); white-space: nowrap; }
.pill.s-draft { color: var(--muted); }
.pill.s-submitted, .pill.s-in_review { background: var(--warn-soft); color: var(--warn); border-color: transparent; }
.pill.s-plan_ready, .pill.s-preview { background: var(--accent-soft); color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }
.pill.s-building { background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--ink); border-color: var(--ink); }
.pill.s-live { background: var(--ok-soft); color: var(--ok); border-color: transparent; }
#statusBar { padding-top: 12px; }
.sbar { width: 100%; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; align-items: center; text-align: left; padding: 10px 14px; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); font-size: 13.5px; }
.sbar:hover { border-color: var(--ink-2); }
.sbtext { color: var(--ink-2); flex: 1; min-width: 160px; }
.tracker { border: 1px solid var(--line); background: var(--surface-2); padding: 18px; display: grid; gap: 14px; }
.trhead { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: start; gap: 10px; }
.steps-v { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; display: grid; gap: 0; }
.steps-v li { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 22px minmax(0, 1fr); gap: 12px; position: relative; padding-bottom: 14px; }
.steps-v li:not(:last-child)::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 7px; top: 18px; bottom: 0; width: 2px; background: var(--line-2); }
.steps-v li.done:not(:last-child)::before { background: var(--accent); }
.bul { width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px solid var(--line-2); background: var(--surface); margin-top: 3px; }
.steps-v li.done .bul { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); }
.steps-v li.now .bul { border-color: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--accent-soft); }
.steps-v .tl { font-weight: 600; font-size: 14.5px; }
.steps-v li.next .tl { color: var(--muted); font-weight: 500; }
.steps-v .td { font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2); }
.approve { display: grid; gap: 10px; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); font-size: 14px; }
.approve .primary { justify-self: start; }
.hist summary { cursor: pointer; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; }
.hist ul { margin: 8px 0 0; padding-left: 18px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--ink-2); display: grid; gap: 4px; }
.teamctl { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; align-items: center; padding-top: 12px; border-top: 1px dashed var(--line-2); }
